Question #: 1.Title: Exam NSE5_FWB_AD-8.0 topic 1 question 18 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: A FortiWeb administrator needs to allow a known web indexer to scan the website for search engine visibility.
What is the easiest way to allow this on FortiWeb?
A. Add the web indexer IP address to the FortiGuard Known Search Engines category.
B. Add the web indexer user-agent string to a custom signature exemption rule.
C. Add the web indexer IP address to the trusted IP address list.
D. Add the web indexer IP address to an IP exception list inside the inline protection profile.

Question #: 2.Title: Exam NSE5_FWB_AD-8.0 topic 1 question 20 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: Users complain that parts of the finances.fortinet.demo page fail to load. You see repeated 500 errors for view.js, view.css and favicon.ico.
What is the most likely cause?
A. The client browser does not support advanced caching headers.
B. The FortiWeb access rate limit is too low to allow all required page components to load.
C. The SSL certificate on FortiWeb is expired and blocks subresources.
D. The server is rejecting HTTPS traffic because it's misconfigured.
